purpose: These three sequences separate the three put conflict modes, the presence/absence of the AFTER INSERT trigger, and the three channel definitions. Sequence 1 distinguishes INSERT OR IGNORE (only first put changes a row) from INSERT OR REPLACE and ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE (all three puts change a row). Sequence 2 adds a delete before the final put, so REPLACE and DO UPDATE differ in whether the final put is an insert or an update, and the trigger fires only on inserts. Sequence 3 wraps the first two puts in a rolled-back transaction, so committed state is empty but channel counters may still reflect the rolled-back changes depending on whether the channel is changes(), total_changes, or total_changes plus other total_changes.
